AgentDriverSpec.description: An explicitly isolated model session and trusted interaction recorder.
AgentDriverSpec.title: AgentDriverSpec

AgentInteraction.description:
One explicit, replayable interaction embedded in a RunEvent.

This records only explicit Agent output and externally observable system data.
Hidden model reasoning is neither requested nor represented by this contract.
AgentInteraction.title: AgentInteraction

CityAuthoredLandscape.description: An author-declared visual polygon, not surveyed or Provider state.
CityAuthoredLandscape.title: CityAuthoredLandscape

CityOrderGeneration.description: Deterministic demand inputs; this never claims that orders were created.
CityOrderGeneration.title: CityOrderGeneration

CityOrderRequest.description: One authoring-only logistics request under the current camelCase shape.
CityOrderRequest.title: CityOrderRequest

CityPerformanceProfile.description: A declared fleet estimate; values are never inferred from display geometry.
CityPerformanceProfile.title: CityPerformanceProfile

CityWorkspaceDraft.description: The active strict workspace-v3 authoring boundary.
CityWorkspaceDraft.title: CityWorkspaceDraft

NetworkMailboxObservationPayload.description: Gateway-schema payload for deliveries closed by one network barrier.
NetworkMailboxObservationPayload.title: NetworkMailboxObservationPayload

PublicTrafficLightFrame.description: Authoritative traffic-light snapshot projected from a SUMO provider event.
PublicTrafficLightFrame.title: PublicTrafficLightFrame

PublicTrafficLightState.description: One controller state read from SUMO TraCI, never locally interpolated.
PublicTrafficLightState.title: PublicTrafficLightState

QueryGrant.description: One explicit, read-only Provider query authorization.
QueryGrant.title: QueryGrant

ResolvedAsset.description:
One byte-exact scenario asset with an exact workload authorization.

World-only measurement, provenance, selector, and license metadata is kept in
``world``. Task assets deliberately leave ``world`` unset rather than
inventing spatial metadata or a license declaration that their source
contract does not provide.
ResolvedAsset.title: ResolvedAsset

ResolvedFlightObservationProjection.description: Provider-safe ownership for Agent-visible flight sensor observations.
ResolvedFlightObservationProjection.title: ResolvedFlightObservationProjection

ResolvedInspectionObservationProjection.description: Redacted task semantics required by an inspection observation provider.
ResolvedInspectionObservationProjection.title: ResolvedInspectionObservationProjection

ResolvedUrbanRecoveryObservationProjecti.description: Provider-safe observation ownership for the urban recovery package.
ResolvedUrbanRecoveryObservationProjecti.title: ResolvedUrbanRecoveryObservationProjection

RunEvent.description: The sole authoritative event envelope for runtime and verifier segments.
RunEvent.title: RunEvent

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum accepted response output tokens; the inspected transport rejects larger responses before exposing any output or tool call.
max_output_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens

StageBarrierDigest.description: One causally prior closed StageBarrier, represented by its digest.
StageBarrierDigest.title: StageBarrierDigest

source_license_status.description: Status of the pinned source-dataset licence record; this does not describe viewer-model licences.
source_license_status.title: Source License Status
